text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Vietnam is expected to export as much as four million tonnes of rice this year.
-- The Ministry of Finance has decided that interest and principal on Treasury paper issues can be paid on maturity or periodically.
-- The Ministry of Planning and Investment has agreed to let BHP Petrolium transfer its interests in the Dai Hung project to Petronas Carigali Snd and Dai Hung Oil Development (Japan) Ltd.
-- Vietnam and Iran have agreed to boost cooperation on various fields, including oil processing and agriculture.
-- The final list of 666 candidates for the coming National Assembly election has been submitted to the National Election Council for official publication.
-- Communist Party Secretary General Do Muoi said strengthening the revolutionary nature of the state and more democracy for the people is needed.
-- Vietnanm will open training courses for workers and technicians to work on plans for a north-south expressway.
